question: Sunil starts from point A and drives 64 km towards the west. He then takes a left turn, drives 63 km, turns left and drives 67 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 78 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

Sunil starts from Point A and drives 64 km towards West.

Then:

• Takes a left turn and drives 63 km

• Takes a left turn and drives 67 km

• Takes a left turn and drives 78 km

• Takes a final left turn and drives 3 km to reach Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d3b618019de76993f5626f24455661883a77375140eb506e5125e4d3c5630e9.png] 

**Now find the shortest distance and direction from P to A:**

Point A = (0, 0)

Point P = (0, 15)

So, Sunil is 15 km North of Point A.

To reach Point A again, he must travel:

**15 km towards South**

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".**
